reason: An in-process OpenAI-compatible proxy for dsh that forwards selected requests to OpenCode Zen while rewriting client identity headers to support the provider's intended quota path.

summaries.zh: 这是一个供 dsh 使用的进程内 OpenAI 兼容代理，将聊天和模型请求转发到 OpenCode Zen 并重写客户端身份请求头。
summaries.en: An in-process OpenAI-compatible proxy for dsh that forwards chat and model requests to OpenCode Zen while rewriting client identity headers.

capabilities: Runs an in-process local HTTP proxy
Forwards OpenAI-compatible chat completion and model requests to an external upstream service
Passes authorization headers and request bodies through to the upstream service
